scope: Actual CreationCore Swift Testing execution on the development Mac. This evidence is distinct from native grammar adapter tests, model generation, App tests and device acceptance.

testRun.countExplanation: The XCTest compatibility shim prints zero tests; the subsequent Swift Testing runner explicitly passed 47 tests.

authoritativeContract.encoding: Deterministic Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema constructed with native Swift/Foundation JSONSerialization, sorted object keys; no script or bundled schema resource.
authoritativeContract.placement: For every primitive: grounded root (neither placement field), origin only, or attach only. Both fields together are forbidden.

dimensionsMeters.minimumReason: ScenePlan.snapshot bridges Float(0.02) through NSNumber; the exact stored Float lower bound preserves valid editable snapshots.

authoritativeContract.freeGeometryCoordinates: Full finite Float range; no artificial +/-1 or +/-3 bound on normalized profile/mesh input coordinates.
authoritativeContract.currentScene: Validated using native attachment resolution; does not reduce IDs, primitive choices or budgets.

verifiedFixtures: An attached child appears first and its unattached root later.
A single editable scene with 1024 mesh vertices/2048 triangles, 64-point lathe and 64-point extrusion, preserved through snapshot/schema validation/native decode/native mesh generation.
Profile values outside the obsolete experimental +/-3 range remain valid.
Exact Float(0.02) snapshot boundary, +/-3 origins and +/-360 rotations.
A 40-grapheme name represented by 80 Unicode scalars remains editable.
All eight primitives with optional placement, rotation and material defaults.
Unknown fields, primitive-inappropriate geometry, type mismatches, invalid counts and numeric bounds rejected as applicable.
Schema-admissible missing parent/cycle/duplicate IDs/out-of-range relative mesh index/degenerate topology still rejected by native validation.
Duplicate raw JSON fields rejected by StrictJSONObject before Foundation collapses them.

nativeOnlySemantics: No self references or graph cycles
Mesh index less than the actual vertex count, nondegenerate triangles and valid profiles
Finite Float representation and all authoritative numeric bounds
Name trimmed nonempty, no control characters, at most 40 Swift extended grapheme clusters
Visual meaning, recognizable silhouette and requested edit intent
nativeValidationBoundary.name: JSON Schema maxLength counts code points rather than Swift extended grapheme clusters; name uses minLength=1 and defers the 40-grapheme rule to native validation. No fake 40-codepoint restriction or huge grammar repetition counter.

responseUTF8Bytes.note: Full Core schema capacity does not imply the maximum-size scene fits the production prompt/output token and byte budgets.

adapterComparison.authoritativeSchemaNumerics: Original schema preserves full number minimum/maximum values.
adapterComparison.pinnedNativeCompilerCompatibility: The adapter separately removes bounds only from type=number schema nodes because pinned xgrammar v0.1.30 rejects valid long decimals/scientific notation. Native numeric validation remains mandatory; integer/count/structural bounds remain in compiled grammar.
adapterComparison.propertyOrder: JSON Schema object semantics and Core decoding are order independent. The pinned native compiler accepts schema property order; emitted schema and ScenePlan.snapshot are sorted, and adapter fixtures compare that canonical order. Reordered equivalent object keys are not claimed accepted by the grammar. Node array order remains unrestricted.
adapterComparison.nativeMatcherEvidence: Native compilation/matcher, fixed TokenIterator and raw-producer tests belong to the separate adapter receipt, not these 47 Core tests.
